page0.text:
"...Phew."
I set down my empty bowl with a clink.
But all of the side dishes on the table are still untouched.
It took all my effort just to focus on my soup and rice, so I didn't even notice the other food.

page1.text:
Sorry, Sakura. But I'm at my wits' end.
I need some time away in my room to cool my head.

page2.text:
"...Um, Senpai? Is breakfast not to your liking?"
"...Oof."
The tactical retreat ends in failure.
My escape route was cut off before I knew it.

page3.text:
"..."
I silently hold out my rice bowl.

page4.text:
"Oh, you want seconds! I made a lot, so be sure to eat it all!"
Sakura returns my bowl with an extra-large helping of rice, and breakfast resumes.

page5.text:
"..."
...Oh, well. I'll just have to deal with this.
I'm already the only one blushing, so I can't let every single thing Sakura does throw me for a loop.

page6.text:
Still, though...
"Wait, Sakura. Don't we have a problem here?"

page7.text:
"Hm? What problem, Senpai?"
She looks at me in puzzlement.
In other words,
Sakura doesn't see a problem with Rider sitting silently next to us.

page8.text:
"I mean..."
I glance at Rider.
She seems to notice the imbalance I'm getting at.
"There's no need to concern yourself with me. Continue your meal."
She urges, just as gracefully as Sakura.

page9.text:
"Huh? Are you worried about her?"
"It appears so. It's true we have come into conflict several times.
He must be uncomfortable sharing a table with an enemy."

page10.text:
"That's not true. Senpai doesn't hold it against you, Rider."
...
...Well, this is a pickle.
I don't resent Rider, but she's on the A-list of people I'm bad at dealing with.

page11.text:
"...Perhaps.
It seems he's having trouble eating because I am here. I can take my leave if I am being a nuisance."
"I'm telling you, it isn't like that. You don't mind if Rider joins us, do you, Senpai?"
